caption: The drawing depicts a stylized composition featuring a bird perched atop a symmetrical floral design. The bird is rendered in yellow and red, with a yellow head and wing, and a red body, tail, and beak, incorporating patches of white on its lower half. Its tail feathers are elaborate, featuring accents of red, yellow, and green, with rounded red tips. The central stem of the plant is red with a symmetrical array of branches and leaves spreading outwards. Each branch has either yellow or red leaves, arranged in balanced pairs from the center. Two large, blue, bell-shaped flowers with red stems and accents are located on either side of the central stem, directly below the bird. The background is a plain, aged beige or light tan color, and at the bottom center of the drawing, there is a rectangular label with printed text that reads: "From A Sympathetic File Made by George Huberer 1799."
title: Drawing for Plate 4: From Portfolio "Folk Art of Rural Pennsylvania"
